confidence_notes: Medium overall. Beer, coffee and restaurant anchors triangulate web search summaries of Da Lat cost-of-living and guide pages (Numbeo, Hikersbay, Livingcost, VietnamSpot). These broadly agree but rest on small, mixed-date samples, and local-currency figures were converted to USD. Cocktail and wine anchors come from bar, rooftop and winery listings rather than restaurant menus. Restaurant by-the-glass wine prices were not found, so both are cross-checked against the local draft-beer price relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation search or live listing check was performed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors are Da Lat-specific; no comparable city was used. Accommodation is a holistic regional estimate for a Vietnamese highland tourist town, based on general knowledge rather than a named comparison city.
